objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote:
Consequently, either

* (i) $g\equiv 0$ (constant), which gives $f(x)=x$, a solution; or  
* (ii) there is $c>0$ such that $V \subseteq \{0, c\}$ with both values attainable.
objection.witness: At most one positive value does not imply that every value is 0 or c; negative values have not been ruled out. If g(x)=a<0, iterating (4) gives g(x+na)=a until the next point is nonpositive, contradicting f(t)=t+a>0.
